exposure: Timing of OAC commencement (<=3 days after birth vs. >3 days after birth)
outcome: Time to commencement of enteral nutritional therapy
Time to recovery of birth weight
Evolution of anthropometric characteristics during hospitalization
cohort: Very low-birth-weight (VLBW) preterm newborns (<1500 g) who received oropharyngeal colostrum administration.
finding: Oropharyngeal colostrum administration (OAC) was associated with a shorter time to recover birth weight and achieve full enteral feeding, with earlier initiation of OAC leading to a significantly shorter time to birth weight recovery.
